description: Software permitted in the DSD pipeline. Every tool is pinned by revision so any output can be reproduced and attributed later. Tool output is always a candidate: no tool listed here may produce publishable content directly.

tools.notes: Apache-2.0. American English with fallback=None. Produces IPA candidates only; a human authors the final pronunciation record.
MIT. General English IPA. Old native dependencies require a feasibility check before adoption.

Internal build tool on DSD-controlled machines only. Not bundled into any customer-distributed client. eSpeak NG in the phonemization path is GPL; program output is not covered, but binary distribution is a separate question kept out of scope.
